metrics.contract_text_verbatim:
FROZEN METRIC DEFINITIONS (verbatim; the freeze experiment implements them in consensus_variants.py; fallback implementers use this text).
For a candidate x of sentence s, P = the parseable peer outputs of s from slots whose family differs from x's family (exp 5 leave-own-family-out, byte-identical to /ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_u75jRHUss0zo/3_invention_loop/iter_2/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_5/src). A(x,p) = the frozen exp-5 ALIGN equivalence modulo vocabulary (z3 2 s; UNKNOWN = not equivalent, counted). E(x,p) = exact equivalence (lowercased names + arity, no aligner).
- V0 c_score_align = 1 - |{p in P: A(x,p)}| / |P|. This is the PRIMARY, pre-declared in iteration 3 and never re-selected.
- V1 c_pn (plurality-normalised) = 1 - min(1, share_A(x) / max_class_share). Classes = the eval-2 pairwise_matrix class ids over P under A. max_class_share = the size of the largest class / |P|. A candidate in the plurality class scores 0.
- V2 c_rw (reliability-weighted) = 1 - sum_{p in P, A(x,p)} w_f(p) / sum_{p in P} w_f(p). w_f = the mean pairwise A-agreement of family f with every other family, over sentences in the OTHER 4 sentence folds (fold = sha1('E_folds_v1|'+sentence_id) % 5 on E; the same recipe with 'E2_folds_v1|' on E2). It is label-free, a Dawid-Skene-style reliability, shrunk toward the grand mean with 20 pseudo-sentences.
- V3 = V1 computed with w_f-weighted shares.
- V4 two-channel = a logistic on (c_exact, c_align), cross-fitted on E's 5 folds for the screen, then refit once on all E R_AB rows and frozen (coefficients in selection.json) for E2.
- V5 = V3 restricted to the eval-2 cross-fitted best 3-pool (deepseek + microsoft + openai), the cost-matched $0.001-per-sentence variant.
- PT p_peer_text = the frozen exp-5 fusion, a SECONDARY row.
- GG (gloss-gated, H-RENAME): x and p agree if E(x,p), OR if an exhaustive injective arity-consistent symbol map from x's symbols onto p's (dataset 5 freelab.equivalent_modulo_vocab_exhaustive, adapted from template atoms to peer symbols, capped at 2e4 maps / 10 s per pair; a cap hit counts as not agreeing) yields z3 equivalence AND the gloss checker confirms that EVERY non-identity mapped symbol pair means the same thing in this sentence. The aligner is NOT used. c_gg = 1 - share of peers agreeing under GG.

comparators.flashlite_disg: google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, vendor_d judges.judge_json(RUBRIC_A, USER_JSON_A, max_tokens=150), disguised view (PRIMARY comparator)
comparators.costmatched_disg: deepseek/deepseek-v3.2, reasoning {enabled: false}, T=0, max_tokens 150, RUBRIC_A + USER_JSON_A byte-identical to flash-lite, judges.parse_judge_json; COST-MATCHED primary
comparators.costmatched_orig: same, original view; all rows if pilot $/call <= 1.6e-4, else frontier subsample + batch prefix
comparators.costmatched_pilot: 30 rows (first 30 parseable rows of batch 1 in sha1 order), both views; parse failure > 10% -> one retry rule max_tokens 300; still > 10% -> NOT_TESTABLE_PARSE
comparators.frontier: google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview via exp-6 api_bar.frontier_judge (effort low, max_tokens 4000), original view, 300-row subsample
comparators.frontier_subsample: drawn after generation, before any label join: cells = words tercile (E2-B sentence cut points) x family (9); 300 rows proportional, min 3 per cell; within cell order sha1('E2B_frontier_v1|'+row_key); inclusion probabilities stored; pilot 10 rows; if > $6e-3/item cut to largest affordable prefix and recompute probabilities; ~2/3 expected usable in R_AB -> wide CI (descriptive)

populations.R_AB: LLM systems only, tiers A+B, excluding CONTESTED and reading_choice (PRIMARY)

E2B_alone.B1: L25_E2B strat AUROC delta V0 - flashlite_disg, strata = word bin, sentence-cluster bootstrap B=2000 percentile 95% CI > 0 (MDE80 0.103, power 0.47 at +0.069; a null is EXPECTED and reported as underpowered alone)
E2B_alone.B2: nested [S4_E2B + V0] - S4_E2B cross-fitted by E2-B sentence folds, CI > 0
E2B_alone.B3: V0 - costmatched_disg with CI, NO directional prediction
E2B_alone.B4: frontier: IPW AUROC, ratio V0/frontier with CI, nested [frontier + V0] - frontier; descriptive

union_fixed_sequence_alpha_0.05.U1: union LONG POOL (L25_E2A + L25_E2B + EXC_E2A) strat delta V0 - flashlite_disg CI > 0, with point > 0 vs flashlite_orig and nano (MDE ~0.057)
union_fixed_sequence_alpha_0.05.U2: union L25 delta, CI > 0 (MDE ~0.075, power ~0.73 at +0.069)
union_fixed_sequence_alpha_0.05.U4: carried H-IMPROVE variant - V0 on the union long pool, CI > 0
union_fixed_sequence_alpha_0.05.rule: each tested at alpha 0.05 only if the previous was confirmed; otherwise descriptive

confirmatory_hierarchy.union_strata: {L25_E2A, L25_E2B, EXC_E2A} x word bin; bootstrap over sentence_id within stratum
confirmatory_hierarchy.heterogeneity: Delta_A - Delta_B with SE = sqrt(SE_A^2 + SE_B^2), Cochran's Q and I^2 over the two L25 samples; reported either way; if CI excludes 0 -> 'effect differs between samples', recheck within 25-29 bin
confirmatory_hierarchy.meta_analysis: fixed-effect inverse-variance pooling of per-sample strat deltas (L25_E2A, L25_E2B, EXC as 3rd component for the long pool); cross-check; disagreement > 0.02 with the pooled bootstrap reported; under significant heterogeneity per-sample results are primary
confirmatory_hierarchy.duplicate_rule: a sentence labelled by both E2-A and E2-B counts once in the union, taking E2-B's copy; kappa of final labels on duplicates reported (test-retest)
confirmatory_hierarchy.regime_rule: if E2-A and E2-B label regimes differ (PASS vs DRIFTED) the union is SECONDARY
